items.title: OpenAI holds DevDay 2026 in San Francisco
items.summary_en: OpenAI published a DevDay 2026 page and recap for its annual developer conference, held on 29 September 2026 in San Francisco. Search snippets indicate more than 20 products and features were announced, with a focus on agents that act on users' behalf.
items.notes: openai.com blocked; URL/title from search; date and '20+ products' count from secondary coverage (Axios, TechCrunch). Related: https://openai.com/index/devday-2026/

items.title: OpenAI introduces 'dots', always-on agents powered by GPT-6 Astra
items.summary_en: According to search snippets of OpenAI's page, dots are agents with their own cloud computer that learn from feedback and work toward user goals continuously. Rollout is beginning for Pro, Business Premium and Enterprise plans in eligible markets.
items.notes: Page not opened; description from search summary; date inferred from DevDay timing. Secondary: https://techcrunch.com/2026/09/29/openai-launches-dots-its-bubbly-agentic-avatar/ and https://www.axios.com/2026/09/29/openai-dev-day-2026-dots-space-sol

items.title: OpenAI introduces GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Astra Ultrafast
items.summary_en: Search snippets describe GPT-6.1 Sol as an upgrade to GPT-6 Sol with strong agentic coding, computer use and professional-work performance, reportedly priced at about a fifth of Astra's token prices. GPT-6 Astra Ultrafast is described as available in the API, ChatGPT Work and Codex on certain plans.
items.notes: Page not opened; date not verified (likely DevDay); pricing/availability need checking.

items.title: Report: OpenAI will not release GPT-6.1 Astra, citing security concerns
items.summary_en: A search summary says OpenAI said this week it would not release its newest flagship model, GPT-6.1 Astra, because of security concerns. No OpenAI primary page confirming this was found.
items.notes: Unverified; claim came from a search summary and the Axios URL is only the closest DevDay coverage. Verify against an OpenAI primary page before use.

coverage_note: Partial. openai.com blocked by egress proxy; no page opened; no item primary-confirmed. Other posts in the window (safety, research, policy) may exist.
